candidate: R8 independent Windows lazy custodian inert prototype
decision: G1 remains closed; this prototype is evidence only and is not an acceptance claim.
limitations: The sync admission negative proves caller API did not return by D; watchdog process termination is not a successful bounded API return.

The independent Python runner held a duplicated outer Job handle and could terminate/query the whole inert process tree. It did not hold the inner worker Job handle or prove inner worker exit details if the native supervisor itself blocks.

The top-level Python subprocess.Popen call synchronously invokes CreateProcessW before Python receives a process handle or the native launcher can duplicate the outer Job handle into the runner; this setup is outside the request D and was not shim-blocked.
The runner's outer communicate watchdog is 8 seconds after Popen returns, not the 1200 ms request budget. Its later Job termination is recovery evidence, not proof of caller return by D.

The native launcher duplicates its outer Job handle to the Python runner only after CreateJobObject, OpenProcess, and DuplicateHandle return. The early control marker then precedes launcher assignment/pipe/child setup; the marker cannot cover hangs before it is emitted.

CreateNamedPipeW, CreateFileW, ConnectNamedPipe, ResumeThread, Job query, TerminateJobObject, CancelIoEx, and CloseHandle are synchronous and were not shim-blocked at their pre-call/post-effect points.
All prewarm work happened before request D; not-ready cases rejected, but a service startup hard deadline is not accepted by this test.

OVERLAPPED cancellation/reaper evidence is one inert pipe write. The owner is a reaper thread in the caller process, not an independently surviving process; it does not establish all connect/read/write/cancellation error paths or IOCP behavior.
The logged Win32 setup/query/terminate/wait/close durations are observed integer-millisecond samples only; zero or short samples do not bound a call that can hang synchronously.
No CTP, native provider, service installation, protected configuration, credential, network route, default preflight, or repository source was accessed or changed.
